main.py

python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Dict, Any

from services.ga_service import get_ga_overview
from services.linkedin_service import get_linkedin_overview
from services.analytics_engine import get_combined_overview

app = FastAPI(title="LeydenJar Analytics Backend")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],  # in production, restrict to your frontend domain
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


class KPIResponse(BaseModel):
    kpis: Dict[str, Any]


@app.get("/api/ga/overview", response_model=KPIResponse)
def ga_overview():
    data = get_ga_overview()
    return {"kpis": data}


@app.get("/api/linkedin/overview", response_model=KPIResponse)
def linkedin_overview():
    data = get_linkedin_overview()
    return {"kpis": data}


@app.get("/api/combined/overview", response_model=KPIResponse)
def combined_overview():
    data = get_combined_overview()
    return {"kpis": data}

from typing import Dict, Any

from .ga_service import get_ga_overview
from .linkedin_service import get_linkedin_overview


def get_combined_overview() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    ga = get_ga_overview()
    li = get_linkedin_overview()

    # Simple example of a combined KPI
    return {
        "traffic_from_linkedin_estimate": int(li["impressions"] * 0.02),
        "sessions": ga["sessions"],
        "users": ga["users"],
        "followers": li["followers"],
        "engagement_rate": li["engagement_rate"],
        "top_countries": ga["top_countries"],
        "linkedin_countries": li["countries"],
    }

src/App.jsx

jsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import Dashboard from "./pages/Dashboard";
import GoogleAnalytics from "./pages/GoogleAnalytics";
import LinkedInAnalytics from "./pages/LinkedInAnalytics";
import ContentInsights from "./pages/ContentInsights";
import Sidebar from "./components/Layout/Sidebar";
import Header from "./components/Layout/Header";

const PASSWORD = process.env.REACT_APP_APP_PASSWORD || "Leydenjar26!";

export default function App() {
  const [authed, setAuthed] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState("dashboard");

  const handleLogin = () => {
    if (input === PASSWORD) {
      setAuthed(true);
    } else {
      alert("Incorrect password");
    }
  };

  if (!authed) {
    return (
      <div className="lj-login">
        <div className="lj-login-card">
          <h1>LeydenJar Analytics</h1>
          <p>Enter password to access the dashboard</p>
          <input
            type="password"
            value={input}
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Password"
          />
          <button onClick={handleLogin}>Enter</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const renderPage = () => {
    switch (page) {
      case "ga":
        return <GoogleAnalytics />;
      case "linkedin":
        return <LinkedInAnalytics />;
      case "content":
        return <ContentInsights />;
      default:
        return <Dashboard />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="lj-app">
      <Sidebar setPage={setPage} />
      <div className="lj-main">
        <Header />
        {renderPage()}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

src/utils/api.js

javascript
import axios from "axios";

const backendUrl = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export async function fetchGAOverview() {
  const res = await axios.get(`${backendUrl}/api/ga/overview`);
  return res.data.kpis;
}

export async function fetchLinkedInOverview() {
  const res = await axios.get(`${backendUrl}/api/linkedin/overview`);
  return res.data.kpis;
}

export async function fetchCombinedOverview() {
  const res = await axios.get(`${backendUrl}/api/combined/overview`);
  return res.data.kpis;
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { fetchCombinedOverview } from "../utils/api";

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchCombinedOverview().then(setData).catch(console.error);
  }, []);

  if (!data) return <div>Loading dashboard...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="lj-page">
      <h2>Combined Overview</h2>
      <div className="lj-kpi-grid">
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Sessions</h3>
          <p>{data.sessions}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Users</h3>
          <p>{data.users}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Followers</h3>
          <p>{data.followers}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Estimated traffic from LinkedIn</h3>
          <p>{data.traffic_from_linkedin_estimate}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Followers</h3>
          <p>{data.followers}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Impressions</h3>
          <p>{data.impressions}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="lj-kpi-tile">
          <h3>Engagement rate</h3>
          <p>{(data.engagement_rate * 100).toFixed(2)}%</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

📌 main.py

python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from services.ga_service import get_ga_overview
from services.linkedin_service import get_linkedin_overview
from services.analytics_engine import get_combined_overview

app = FastAPI(title="LeydenJar Analytics Backend")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],  # Restrict later to your Vercel domain
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

@app.get("/api/ga/overview")
def ga_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_ga_overview()}

@app.get("/api/linkedin/overview")
def linkedin_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_linkedin_overview()}

@app.get("/api/combined/overview")
def combined_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_combined_overview()}

md
# LeydenJar Backend

FastAPI backend powering the LeydenJar Analytics Cockpit.

## Endpoints

### `/api/ga/overview`
Returns Google Analytics KPIs.

### `/api/linkedin/overview`
Returns LinkedIn Analytics KPIs.

### `/api/combined/overview`
Returns unified KPIs combining GA4 + LinkedIn.

## Deployment

Deploy on Render using Dockerfile.
Add environment variables for GA4 + LinkedIn.

# LeydenJar Backend

FastAPI backend powering the LeydenJar Analytics Cockpit.

## Endpoints

### `/api/ga/overview`
Returns Google Analytics KPIs.

### `/api/linkedin/overview`
Returns LinkedIn Analytics KPIs.

### `/api/combined/overview`
Returns unified KPIs combining GA4 + LinkedIn.

## Deployment

Deploy on Render using Dockerfile.
Add environment variables for GA4 + LinkedIn.

⭐ 1️⃣ main.py

Save as: main.py

Code
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from services.ga_service import get_ga_overview
from services.linkedin_service import get_linkedin_overview
from services.analytics_engine import get_combined_overview

app = FastAPI(title="LeydenJar Analytics Backend")

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

@app.get("/api/ga/overview")
def ga_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_ga_overview()}

@app.get("/api/linkedin/overview")
def linkedin_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_linkedin_overview()}

@app.get("/api/combined/overview")
def combined_overview():
    return {"kpis": get_combined_overview()}

⭐ 3️⃣ Dockerfile

Save as: Dockerfile

Code
FROM python:3.11

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

ENV PORT=8000

CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

Save as: analytics_engine.py

Code
from .ga_service import get_ga_overview
from .linkedin_service import get_linkedin_overview

def get_combined_overview():
    ga = get_ga_overview()
    li = get_linkedin_overview()

    return {
        "traffic_from_linkedin_estimate": int(li["impressions"] * 0.02),
        "sessions": ga["sessions"],
        "users": ga["users"],
        "followers": li["followers"],
        "engagement_rate": li["engagement_rate"],
        "top_countries": ga["top_countries"],
        "linkedin_countries": li["countries"],
    }
